title: Anthony Joshua discharged from hospital as driver in fatal car crash arrested
summary: The driver of the car involved in the fatal crash in which two friends of British boxer Anthoy Joshua were killed has been held by police in Lagos. Joshua had a lucky escape from the accident on the busy highway between Lagos and Ibadan on December 29 and was discharged from hospital on January 1. FRANCE 24's Sam Olukoya has more, from Abuja in Nigeria.
